marketing.text: This is B C T Labs. Since twenty thirteen, we have been putting the right components into the hands of makers, students and engineers across India.
It starts with a storefront that respects your time. Sixty six parts, twelve categories, and one warehouse in Bengaluru. Every listing you see is stock we actually hold.
Browse by category, or narrow it down. Filter by price, availability, and the specs that matter. What you see is what is on the shelf.
Open any part, and you get the details an engineer needs. The exact variant, the specifications, the price, and live stock. Add it to the cart in one tap.
Your cart keeps the maths simple. Subtotal, delivery and any discount are clear before you commit. No surprises at the end.
Checkout works for guests as well as account holders. Enter your details once, and we save the address to your book for next time.
Pay with U P I, cards, net banking or wallets, through Cashfree. The payment is confirmed on our server, never in the browser. An order is only marked paid when the money is really there.
The moment it clears, you get an order number, a GST invoice, and a tracking link. You can follow the parcel without ever creating an account.
Signed in, your address book and order history stay in one place. Reorder in two taps.
And when it ships, the tracking page shows exactly where your parcel is, and when it will reach you.
B C T Labs. Components that build the future. Bengaluru, India.

admin.text: Now the other side. The B C T Labs admin console, where every order, customer and shipment is managed.
Staff sign in with a dedicated admin account. Customers never see this area.
The dashboard is your morning briefing. Revenue, open orders, customers and low stock, all on one screen.
Orders arrive here the moment someone checks out. Statuses are live. Processing, shipped, delivered, failed. Search by order number, or filter by status and date.
Open an order, and everything is in one place. Line items, payment status, the shipping address, and the full timeline of what happened, and when.
From here you create the shipment. Rates and serviceability come from Nimbus Post, and the A W B is booked against the order without leaving the page.
Products holds the catalogue and the stock. Price, variant, category and availability are edited in place, and low stock is flagged before it becomes a problem.
Customers shows who is buying. Contact details, saved addresses, order count and lifetime value, so support can answer without digging.
Logistics collects the day's shipments into a manifest, ready for pickup. Tracking updates flow back through a signed webhook, and update the order automatically.
Payments are reconciled by webhook. The signature is checked against the raw request body, and the amount is validated against the stored order, before anything is marked paid.
Contact messages and enquiries land in Messages, so nothing gets lost in an inbox.
One console for the storefront, the money, and the parcels. That is B C T Labs admin.
